summary: Document the unverified list and folder write gaps instead of advertising schema-only operations.
reason: The AnyList protobuf schema contains list sharing, notification-location, store-order, and folder-parent fields, but the current client has no verified senders for list rename, sharing/invites, notification changes, list settings writes, folder rename, reorder, parent membership, or nesting. Folder create/delete are already fail-closed after disposable typed writes acknowledged HTTP success without persistence. List create/delete use verified protobuf operations, list reset uses the existing item-removal path, and lists settings is a cached read only. No new live mutation was attempted in this documentation slice.
validated_outcome: README, SKILL, MCP resources, endpoint summaries, and the generated tools manifest now identify the supported list operations and explicitly mark list rename, sharing/invites, notification locations, settings writes, folder rename, reorder, parent membership, and nesting as unavailable or unverified. No command was added for a schema-only operation and no live data changed.
